## Summary

Describe the change and the existing user behavior it affects.

## Verification

- [ ] `ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure` passes, or explain which relevant checks were run and why others could not run.
- [ ] Added or updated a focused regression check for behavior changes.
- [ ] Documentation links and screenshots use public, reviewed assets only.

## Scope and provenance

- [ ] No private user project, credential, proprietary Adobe material, or unlicensed asset is included.
- [ ] New dependencies, fixtures, fonts, and generated files have documented sources and license status.
- [ ] Unsupported features remain described as unsupported; no unverified AE parity claim was added.
